attributes.description: Invoke one of a fixed allow-list of Ignition translation functions: util.translate, i18n.translate, i18n.listKeys (reads) and util.modifyTranslation, i18n.modifyTranslations (translation writes). Pass the dotted name without the system. prefix; positional args in args, keyword args in kwargs (a single dict in args is treated as kwargs). Any other function is refused with {ok: false, error, allowed}. Returns {ok: true, result} on success; Java-backed values are serialized via repr().
attributes.title: systemCall

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: one of: util.translate, i18n.translate, i18n.listKeys, util.modifyTranslation, i18n.modifyTranslations ('system.' prefix optional)
